rationale.complete: Rounds 1 and 1b plus round 2 (H15-R1-R3): pre-registered, synthetic-validated tests of stigmergic recovery (re-read share, trail dose-response, memory-loss re-acquisition), scramble by proxy of the first reads after a wipe, and the enactment of consolidation notes, with power statements for every null. Reserved data not run; trail and memory-loss tests inconclusive.
rationale.faithfulness: Memory-is-load-bearing predictions failed again on corrected data; the erasure dip replicated with dated predictions on independent timing and output data (E 0 -> 1), memory dose does not buffer it, and the artifact-store rival failed. KW signature (plateau, eta) still untestable; D2.6 inconclusive for the pre-registered pool. Scorecard A1 B1 C1 D0 E1 F1 G1 H1 I1. Round 2: dated unfitted predictions held (pooled message value, note-pointer null, retrospective notes, decay) and two redirect claims were rejected (first reads hold the value; notes performative). Scorecard A1 B1 C1 D1 E1 F1 G1 H1 I1.
rationale.usefulness: The operator number stays the cost of the 41-call cap (about a tenth of committed work). Round 2 adds that re-showing the last files or newest messages after a wipe would recover at most a few percent of it, and that consolidation notes are about 11% enacted, so a longer cap, not a better note, is the lever.

one_line: A forced context wipe costs 39% of committed work for 10 calls; the value is not in the few items read first (4% of the dip), and memory notes are about 11% enacted.

v2.claim: In regime III (9 periods; 20,592 forced wipes against 21,806 pseudo-wipes), the context window's value is not held in the few items read first after a wipe: re-opening the last files (RR 1.10 [1.01, 1.21]) and new messages (1.14 [1.02, 1.28]) soften the 41% dip but together carry 4% [−23, +26] of it; consolidation notes are partly enacted rather than performative (window-swap excess recall 0.090 [0.076, 0.104], about 11% of their content)
v2.decision: scaffold design: restoring the first-read items after a wipe recovers little; memory notes carry ~11% of their content into action
v2.rater: 2 raters (coordinator + blind); log-odds mean credence, mean V; mechanism level = lower of the two; Δp 0.13, ΔV 1.00 (no adjudication needed)
